pdf.viewer_subtitle: Inspect source PDFs, highlight quoted evidence, and overlay bounding-box matches from locate_quote_bboxes output.
pdf.legend_verified_exact: Quote matches the source word for word.
pdf.legend_verified_normalized: Quote matches after normalizing whitespace and punctuation.
pdf.legend_verified_fuzzy: Quote matches approximately — minor OCR or formatting drift.
pdf.legend_not_found: Quote could not be located in the cited document.
pdf.legend_not_applicable: No citation check applies to this cell.
pdf.empty_hint: Upload a PDF or open one from a URL to start reviewing evidence.

settings.subtitle: Master-key access, model routing, system health and the audit trail.
settings.byok_note: The master key authenticates OpenMatrix itself and is kept in memory only — never stored. Provider API keys (BYOK) are entered on the Analysis page per request, sent once with that request, and never persisted.
settings.router_default_note: Configured default model identifier — may be a routing placeholder, not a concrete provider model.
settings.router_load_failed: Could not load the model routing configuration.
settings.router_empty: The model router did not return a configuration.

quality.title: Quality Review
quality.subtitle: Audit citation accuracy, failure hotspots and answer shape across every matrix run.
quality.cell_status_hint: Outcome distribution of extraction cells — a healthy run is mostly completed.
quality.citation_status_hint: How quoted evidence verified against the source documents.
quality.avg_answer_length_hint: Answer length per cell status — unusually long answers may signal padding.
quality.total_cells_hint: Extraction cells parsed across all matrix runs.
quality.most_failed_questions_hint: Questions that failed most often — candidates for rewording or model changes.
quality.verification_rate_hint: Share of completed cells whose citation verified against the source.
